hook: but who's taking care of you?
lines: But who's taking care of the *builder?*
You tell yourself you'll rest when you *make* it.
#But if the builder breaks, the building *stops.*
#Your body is the only one you'll ever *have.*
Your mind is the engine behind *everything.*
#Taking care of yourself isn't a *reward* for success.
Talk to someone when it gets *heavy.*
#You can't build a great life in a broken *body.*
#So tonight, take care of the builder.
end: Send this to someone who forgets to rest.

cover.sub: If you break, the building stops

post.title: Who's Taking Care of the Builder?
post.caption: Taking care of yourself isn't a reward for success. It's the foundation. 🤍
post.first_comment: What's one thing you'll do for yourself tonight? 👇
